Jared — thanks for the bundle. I reviewed the attachments briefly and shared with procurement. A few asks to keep the activation moving: 

1) Please confirm whether Clearmap will accept our standard Redwood DPA (I attached the template we use internally when onboarding vendors). If yes, sign/return via DocuSign and we can attach to the vendor record.

2) We need an explicit, machine-readable subprocessor list (CSV is great) and fields for data location (region) and legal basis for transfers. The CSV you sent looks fine but can you add a column for data-at-rest region?

3) Procurement requires a billing contact and W-9 (or foreign equivalent). Can AP send the billing email we should populate on the PO?

4) Proposed timeline: if DPA signed by Wed 2026-09-02 and PO issued by Procurement by Fri 2026-09-04, we can have Clearmap enabled in Prod by the following week. Please confirm any blockers.
